_note: Gate results from docs/PROGRESS.md. Update when a gate passes. Eval results come from public/evals-report.json (make evals).

gates.title: Twelve simulated neighbours, locally
gates.result: 12 of 12 cases settled with the right classification; both hidden-urgent residents escalated; 0 policy violations; 53.6 s.
gates.how: make local-drill, 158 unit tests including 29 Cedar cases and a 300-case backstop property test.

gates.title: A person's answer survives a restart
gates.result: An interrupt raised in one process was answered in another; the volunteer task was sent exactly once; a second tap was recognised as already answered.
gates.how: tests/test_restart_resume.py, plus 12 real Telegram taps over 8 decisions (one decision tapped five times).

gates.title: The whole drill in the cloud
gates.result: 12 of 12 settled on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime; paused in one runtime process, resumed in another by a real Telegram tap; 2,059 trace spans; 0 secrets in 20,500 log events.
gates.how: make cloud-restart-test (18/18), make cloud-drill with Telegram, make scan-logs.

gates.title: Real voice, browser and phone
gates.result: Three consecutive browser calls and three real phone calls on Nova 2 Sonic. When a resident said "I feel dizzy and confused", the captain's Telegram page was sent 15.3 s before the call ended.
gates.how: Deployed voice runtime and a Twilio subaccount calling the operator's own allowlisted phone; Cedar refused every non-allowlisted resident.

gates.title: A stranger can try it in under four minutes
gates.result: Fresh private browsers, real voice: laptop 1 min 39 s and phone 1 min 07 s from opening the site to reading the report, including a voice call that paged the captain about 14 s before hang-up and a decision answered on the dashboard.
gates.how: Lighthouse accessibility 100 on every page (desktop and mobile), a keyboard-only pass in real Chrome, and a test of every cost cap and the kill switch against the live API.
